description: Agent Grants: submit a grant closeout record with the award terms: the closeout with the grant, the currency, whether and when the final report was filed, the totals awarded and spent, the unspent balance, what was done with it (return, retain, carry_forward or reallocate) and the amount returned, each item bought with grant funds with its disposition, and the last day the records are kept; the terms with the grant, the currency, the last day of the grant period, the final report due day, what happens to an unspent balance, each disposition rule for items bought with grant funds and the retention duty in years after the period or as a day. The signed report gives the closeout and the terms, the final report against its due day, the unspent balance and its disposition against the balance rule with the amount returned, each item paired with the rule for it and its disposition on both sides, and the day the records are kept against the day the terms require, and counts them, and names a divergent closeout: a final report not filed or filed late, another currency, an unspent balance handled otherwise than the terms say or not fully returned, an item disposed of otherwise than its rule and records kept for less time than required; then a stated balance unlike the awarded and spent totals, an item no rule covers and another grant name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No filing where a final report is due, no disposition for an unspent balance, no amount returned, items with no disposition, no retention day, or terms with no grant end for a retention in years leaves the closeout unverified. Days read as days, amounts compare to the cent in one currency, dispositions read by their words with plurals folded, and the retention day is the stated day or the same day the stated years after the grant period ends. Grant funds are not purchase payments and nothing here is a refund: wever_refund-eligibility-check, wever_refund-rule-check and wever_refund-path-check read refund eligibility, rules and routes on purchases, while an unspent balance at closeout follows the award terms, not a refund rule; and wever_data-retention-check reads a data retention and deletion policy, while the closeout check reads the retention duty the award sets for the grant records against the closeout. Verdict grant_closeout_divergent, grant_closeout_partial, grant_closeout_unverified or grant_closeout_consistent. POST /api/grant-closeout-check. Reads the grant records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never applies for a grant, awards one, disburses or moves any money, or judges the merit of an applicant, a project, or a funder’s decision, only whether the records agree with each other and with the terms they were written under, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Grants reads a grant’s records for consistency between documents: a grant application, a proposed budget, an award letter or grant agreement, milestone records, disbursement records, spending records, a progress or final report and a closeout record, each against the call or guidelines, the terms in the call or award, the application as submitted, the schedules in the award, the approved budget, the records it summarizes or the award terms it should agree with. Beside it, the conditional payments rail tools such as wever_conditional-create create, fund, cancel and report on payments held against conditions between parties, keeping state and moving money, and the Job Records tools such as wever_job-cost-brief read the records of paid work orders, while this family keeps no state, moves nothing, commissions no work and reads the grant records in the call against each other and against the terms they were written under. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-grants-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-grants/.
